title: Cardputer TV
summary: Cardputer Zero 轻量视频播放器，支持自定义源及帧率设置；订阅兼容性仅做有限样本测试。
description:
Cardputer TV 是面向 M5Stack Cardputer Zero 的原生 C++20 轻量直播与视频播放器，适配 320×170 屏幕、机身键盘、音频输出及外接 HDMI 大屏。

【核心功能】
• 自定义播放源：支持 M3U/M3U8、频道 JSON（含注释）、HTTP(S)/HLS 及部分 TVBox 明文直播列表；HLS 弱网时可自动切换低码率。
• 原生单路播放：内置屏幕直调 FFmpeg C API（libav*）与 PulseAudio（libpulse），以音频为主时钟同步画音并支持欠载保护；切台保留最后一帧并提示状态，不双路预加载。
• 音量与偏好记忆：播放中每次增减 5%（0–100%），左下角带音量进度条；退出自动恢复进入前的系统音量，升级保留源和设置。
• 播放设置：20 / 30 / 60 fps、内置屏幕 / HDMI 大屏（mpv wlshm）、内屏 H.264 硬解开关（失败自动回退软解）、中/英文实时切换。

【快速按键】
• 列表：F/X（或上下/K/J）选台（长按加速），Z/C（或左右）翻页，回车播放，Tab 源管理（N 新增 / E 编辑 / 退格删 / R 刷新），S 设置，Esc/Q 退出。
• 播放中：F/X 切台，Z/C 调音量，Esc 停止返回。

【源导入与说明】
• 可用 SFTP/ADB 将 UTF-8 格式的 sources.json 传至 ~/.config/cardputer-zero-iptv/sources.json（建议权限 600，覆盖前请先退出应用并备份），或在源管理按 N 新增本地路径并按 R 刷新。
• 仅自带 Big Buck Bunny 公开测试流，不附带私人/商业源；不支持 DRM 解密及 jar/spider 点播脚本。第三方源与复杂订阅仅做有限样本验证，兼容性与流畅度以实际环境为准。

【运行与许可】
依赖 libav* / libpulse0 / libcurl4t64 / libidn2-0 / libfreetype6 / libpng16-16t64 / libevdev2（HDMI 可选 mpv、wlr-randr）；需读取键盘与写 framebuffer 权限，安装脚本仅设为 0755。源码未声明开源协议（NOASSERTION），内置文泉驿微米黑字体遵循 Apache-2.0。

【版本 0.3.0 更新】
• 全栈重构为原生 C++20 + LVGL v9 + FFmpeg/PulseAudio 单二进制应用（运行约 39 MiB 内存）。
• 全新「深曜石橙影」界面与 256×256 微拟物桌面图标，OSD 新增音量进度条，长分组自动单行省略，长频道名跑马灯。
• 新增内屏 V4L2 硬解开关与回退、HDMI 输出、中英文实时切换、退出恢复系统音量，并修复虚拟键盘重复触发导致的选台跳跃问题。

---

Cardputer TV is a lightweight native C++20 live stream and video player for M5Stack Cardputer Zero, built for the 320×170 panel, keypad, speaker, and external HDMI output.

[Features]
• Custom Sources: Supports M3U/M3U8, JSON channel lists (with comments), HTTP(S)/HLS streams, and select plaintext TVBox live lists, with automatic lower-bitrate HLS fallback on slow networks.
• Native Single-Stream Playback: Built-in panel playback directly uses FFmpeg C API (libav*) and PulseAudio (libpulse) with an audio-master A/V clock and underrun freeze protection. Channel zapping stops the old stream first and keeps the last frame cleanly without dual-stream preloading.
• Volume & Persistence: Adjusts volume in 5% steps (0–100%) with a bottom progress OSD and automatically restores your pre-launch system volume on exit. Existing sources and preferences are preserved across upgrades.
• Settings (press S): 20 / 30 / 60 fps target, Built-in Screen / HDMI (via mpv wlshm), Hardware H.264 Decode toggle (auto-falls back to software if unavailable), and instant 中文 / English switching.

[Controls]
• List: F/X (or Up/Down/K/J) move (hold to accelerate), Z/C (or Left/Right) page, Enter/Space play, Tab Sources (N add / E edit / Bksp delete / R refresh), S Settings, Esc/Q quit.
• Playback: F/X zap channel, Z/C adjust volume, Esc stop and return.

[Sources & Notes]
• Import custom lists by copying UTF-8 sources.json to ~/.config/cardputer-zero-iptv/sources.json (chmod 600 recommended; close the app and back up first), or add local list paths in the Sources screen.
• Ships only with the public Big Buck Bunny demo stream—no private or paid playlists included. DRM streams and jar/spider VOD scripts are not supported. Third-party playlists and TVBox variants have limited sample coverage.

[Requirements & License]
Requires framebuffer/evdev permissions and PulseAudio/PipeWire-Pulse; dependencies are declared in the .deb package (optional mpv and wlr-randr for HDMI). Post-install script only sets 0755 permissions. Source code carries NOASSERTION; bundled WenQuanYi Micro Hei font is licensed under Apache-2.0 (see fonts/).

[What's New in 0.3.0]
• Rewritten from Python into native C++20 + LVGL v9 + FFmpeg C API + libpulse (~39 MiB RSS).
• New "Obsidian Amber" rounded-card UI, redesigned 256×256 icon, volume progress OSD, single-line group truncation, and marquee titles.
• Added V4L2 H.264 hardware decode option, HDMI mode, instant Chinese/English UI toggle, automatic system volume restore, and fixed duplicate input event skipping on keypad zapping.
